name: stepped tower
caption: A stepped tower with three stacked sections and a stepped crown. Four flat walls rise from a base; a stepped crown caps the top. Faceted walls keep a constant thickness with a stepped crown line. Overall width is 0.85 times depth; height is 2.20 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous cream, dark brown, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
